Upstream provenance for vendor/tensorcash-v1.2.2/
===================================================

repository : https://git.tensorcash.org/tensorcash/tensorcash
tag        : v1.2.2
commit     : 48d1344106044338e6e500de7e95869de036bc55

Every file listed below is a byte-identical copy of the file at the same
relative path in that commit. Nothing in this directory is edited locally:
the miner compiles these sources unchanged (renamed namespaces are applied
with compiler -D definitions in CMakeLists.txt, never by editing a file).
tools/check-vendored-precheck.sh recomputes the hashes below and fails on any
difference.

Licenses
--------
* Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE, NOTICE and LICENSING.md, verbatim from the
  upstream repository root): every file under shared-utils/pow-utils/ except
  the two groups below. LICENSING.md maps shared-utils/pow-utils/ to
  first-party Apache-2.0.
* MIT, CORE-MATH (Copyright (c) 2022-2025 Alexei Sibidanov):
  shared-utils/pow-utils/coremath/{exp.c,log.c,dint.h}. Licence text in the
  file headers; provenance and the two documented upstream edits to exp.c in
  coremath/PROVENANCE.txt.
* MIT, Bitcoin Core (Copyright (c) 2009-2010 Satoshi Nakamoto, 2009-2022 The
  Bitcoin Core developers): the arith_uint256 subset in
  shared-utils/pow-utils/bcore_compat/arith_uint256.h (licence in its header).
